poc_plan: Objective: validate Dedicated capacity for 750-900 req/s mixed workload with p95 latency < 350ms for 128-token responses
Test artifacts: anonymized prompt sets (chat/onboarding), embeddings corpus (10k queries), rerank set (5k requests)
Load test phases: 1) Warmup 30m at 20% of target; 2) Ramp to 50% over 45m; 3) Peak sustained run at target for 4h; 4) Spike tests at 2x target for 30m
Soak test: continuous mixed workload for 48 hours at 80% of target to detect memory growth, KV cache thrash, and throughput drift
Tail-latency focus: capture p50/p90/p95/p99 for each model variant and request size; correlate with GPU utilization and batch sizes
Quantization matrix: run the same workload on int8 and 4-bit quantized variants to measure throughput/cost tradeoffs
Fallback policy validation: simulate a node loss and verify automatic routing to smaller model variant with graceful latency degradation
Burst behavior: exercise burst to shared pool (if capacity constrained) to validate overflow pricing and latency impact
Metrics: token/sec, requests/sec, GPU %util, GPU memory, avg batch size, queue depth, KV cache hit rate, error rate, cold-start latencies
Acceptance criteria: no more than 2% errors during sustained run; p95 <= 350ms for chat 128-token; embeddings p95 < 120ms; no progressive resource leaks observed
Deliverables: raw traces, perf dashboards, sizing recommendation (GPU type + count), cost projection, SLA latency SLO draft
performance_requirements: Throughput target: 750-900 req/s mixed workload (chat + embeddings + rerank)
Latency SLO: chat p95 <= 350ms for 128-token responses; embeddings p95 <= 120ms
Availability target: 99.95% (monthly) with credits for sustained misses
Burst policy: support 2x baseline for up to 30 minutes without SLA penalty, subject to overflow pricing
Regional residency: production traffic must serve EU customers from EU-dedicated pool; failover to NA only during region outage
Model mapping: primary Llama2-70B-quantized, fallback Llama2-13B-int8 for concurrency spikes
reserved_gpu_planning: Initial recommendation: 8x H100-80GB (or equivalent) for primary pool to meet sustained throughput
Alternate: 16x A100-80GB if customer prefers A100 procurement — requires different kernel tuning
Autoscaling: configure reserved baseline at 70% utilization with burst to shared pool for headroom
KV cache strategy: partitioned cache per-shard with 128GB aggregate KV cache to reduce prefix recomputation
Nightly maintenance window: schedule rolling restarts with 1% capacity buffer to ensure SLA during maintenance
Cost sensitivity: provide cost/throughput delta table for A100 vs H100 vs a mixed fleet
sla_negotiation_points: Latency SLOs and definition (p95 vs p99) — customer requests p95 but wants p99 clause for critical paths
Uptime: 99.95% with service credits; define downtime measurement and exclusion windows
Data residency commitments: region pinning + contractual definition of failover conditions
Response credits: staged credit schedule for repeated misses; customer pushing for financial cap reduction
Support SLA: 1-hour P1 response, 24/7 on-call for incident escalation during pilot
Termination/exit: data purge timeline + handoff support for on-prem migration if needed
notes_summary: Enterprise finance app evaluating Dedicated. Need throughput/latency validation with reserved GPU sizing. Legal/residency and SLA latency credits are primary commercial blockers.
